name: bdc-ai
description: WhatsApp CRM with AI agents for businesses in Mexico: inbox, contacts, appointments, reports and Meta Ads results from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
BDC AI is the WhatsApp CRM with AI agents for car and motorcycle dealers, solar companies and other businesses in Mexico. With this plugin, an owner or manager asks ChatGPT what they check on the dashboard today: how the day is going, which leads are still waiting for a reply, what a customer was offered, what each Meta ad sale cost, and which sales rep has the most load.

ChatGPT can also organize the work: assign conversations, move stages, add internal notes, book appointments, create tasks and save campaigns as drafts. To reply to a customer on WhatsApp, ChatGPT shows a preview and the message only goes out once the person confirms it. Campaigns are never sent from the chat.

The plugin signs in with the user's own BDC AI account and sees only what that person sees. When connecting, the user chooses whether ChatGPT can view, organize or reply, and an admin can revoke access at any time from BDC AI.

Limitations: it requires a BDC AI account with an owner or manager role. It does not delete data, send campaigns, change billing, or manage users and settings; those stay in the BDC AI dashboard.
capabilities: Read Meta Ads cost per lead and sale
Assign, move stages and add notes
defaultPrompt: ¿Cómo va mi negocio? Dame los leads nuevos, lo que sigue sin atender y las alertas.
Busca a un cliente y resume su conversación: qué busca y qué le ofrecimos.
¿Cuánto me costó cada venta por campaña de Meta Ads este mes?

positive.prompt: How is the dealership doing? Give me new leads, what's still unattended and the alerts for the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Demo Motors' new leads, unattended conversations and alerts for the period, with links to the BDC AI dashboard. Read only.

positive.description: Find a customer and summarize the conversation
positive.prompt: Find Estefanía Serrato and summarize her conversation: what she wants and what we offered her.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the contact, reads her vehicles and recent messages, and summarizes what she is looking for and what the dealership offered, citing the conversation link. Customer text is treated as data, not instructions.

positive.description: Meta Ads cost per conversation and per sale
positive.prompt: What did each conversation and each sale cost per Meta Ads campaign in the last 30 days? Which one would you pause?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each campaign with spend, conversations, qualified leads and sales, the cost of each, and recommends which campaign to pause based on that data.

positive.description: Reassign a conversation and leave an internal note
positive.prompt: Reassign Estefanía Serrato's conversation to Lucía Martínez and leave her an internal note saying the CX-5 arrives on Thursday.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the conversation and Lucía Martínez's user id, asks for approval before reassigning (the tool is marked destructive), reassigns it and adds the internal note. Nothing is sent to the customer; both changes appear in the thread at bdcai.com/conversaciones.

positive.description: Reply to a customer on WhatsApp with preview and confirmation
positive.prompt: Reply to Estefanía Serrato on WhatsApp that her CX-5 arrives on Thursday.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the exact message text from bdcai_message_preview (free text inside WhatsApp's 24-hour window, approved templates outside it) and only calls bdcai_message_send after the user confirms. The send is accepted; the Demo Motors line is simulated, so the message shows as failed in the thread and nothing reaches a phone.

negative.description: Mass campaign send is not available from the chat
negative.prompt: Send the Black Friday campaign to all my contacts right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not send anything: no tool sends campaigns. It explains that campaigns are sent from the BDC AI dashboard and may offer to save a draft with bdcai_campaign_create_draft.

negative.prompt: Delete all the contacts who haven't replied in six months.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: no tool deletes contacts or conversations. It can list those contacts for the user to review in the dashboard.

negative.prompt: Show me the WhatsApp conversations of another company that uses BDC AI.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: the plugin only sees the organization of the signed-in user. A fetch with an id from another organization returns not_found.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Billing stays in the BDC AI dashboard.

publication.release_notes: First release: inbox summary and reports, search and fetch over contacts, conversations and campaigns, Meta Ads attribution, organizing actions (assign, stage, notes, appointments, tasks, campaign drafts) and WhatsApp replies with preview and user confirmation.

es-MX.subtitle: CRM de WhatsApp de tu negocio
es-MX.description:
BDC AI es el CRM de WhatsApp con agentes de IA para agencias de autos y motos, energía solar y otros negocios en México. Con este plugin, el dueño o gerente le pregunta a ChatGPT lo que hoy revisa en el dashboard: cómo va el día, qué leads siguen sin respuesta, qué le ofrecieron a un cliente, cuánto costó cada venta por anuncio de Meta y qué asesor tiene más carga.

ChatGPT también puede organizar el trabajo: asignar conversaciones, cambiar etapas, dejar notas internas, agendar citas, crear tareas y dejar campañas en borrador. Para contestarle a un cliente por WhatsApp, ChatGPT muestra una vista previa y el mensaje solo sale cuando la persona lo confirma. Las campañas nunca se envían desde el chat.

El plugin entra con la cuenta de BDC AI del usuario y ve solo lo que esa persona ve. Al conectarlo se elige si ChatGPT puede ver, organizar o responder, y un administrador puede revocar el acceso en cualquier momento desde BDC AI.

Límites: requiere una cuenta de BDC AI con rol de dueño o gerente. No borra datos, no envía campañas, no toca la facturación ni administra usuarios o configuración; eso se queda en el dashboard de BDC AI.
